# NV Ball Real Estate Group

> An all-female team of licensed Nevada REALTORS® with lpt Realty, serving Reno, Sparks, Carson City, the Carson Valley (Gardnerville, Minden, Genoa), Lake Tahoe, Dayton, Fernley, and Fallon. Led by Sage Ball. Specialists in Bay Area–to–Nevada relocation. Office: 1755 E Plumb Lane Ste 251, Reno NV 89502 · (775) 854-2597 · sage@nvballrealty.com.

## Facts
- Nevada has no state personal income tax; many clients relocate from the Bay Area
- Team of 12 licensed Nevada REALTORS®; 93 homes sold in the twelve months through October 2026; response standard for new inquiries is under five minutes in business hours
- The team's twenty most recent Google reviews are all five stars
- Every page is written or reviewed by practicing local agents; the site does not publish invented market statistics
